dihedral_encoding.note: CDR3 dihedrals alpha_N/alpha_C are encoded as cos(angle); wraparound-safe near the +/-180 branch cut. tau_N/tau_C are bounded bond angles and stay linear. (Unchanged from v0.2.0.)

contact_nres.formula: sum over non-stem CDR3 residues of 1/(1+exp((d_min_to_FR2 - midpoint)/width))
contact_nres.note: Number of CDR3 residues contacting FR2 (soft-weighted by each residue's closest approach to any FR2 contact residue, AHo 44-55). Replaces v0.2.0 contact_density: NOT normalised by loop length, so a localised contact in a long, otherwise-extended loop registers fully - matching the expert 'any CDR3-FR2 contact => kinked' rule.

fr2_rsa_key.note: Relative SASA at FR2 AHo position 44 only (v0.2.0 used 44+54). Position 44 carries almost all the RSA signal; 54 was near-noise and diluted the feature.

performance.note: heldout = unique test∪unseen minus train and all 46 expert structures (the original test/unseen splits overlap by 73, so are collapsed).
